usageContracts.structural: Eight invoke suffixes per claudeUsage/codexUsage/openCodeUsage. Bare getScanState ignores arguments; setEnabled reads args.enabled; query handlers read args.scope/range and optional limit/kind. refresh reads args?.force ?? false. No request or result schema and no sender test in these raw ipcMain.handle callbacks. Type annotations do not validate inputs.
usageContracts.errors: Missing/null whole arguments throw for property-reading handlers, but primitives may yield undefined properties; extras ignored. Nonboolean enabled survives in memory and is subject to JSON omission/coercion at persistence. No cancellation token or registration disposer. Register-core guard owns one-time setup; preload exposure/isolation remains a separate admission boundary.
usageContracts.host: Stores/cache live in main process userData; no runtime-host parameter, no implicit remote provider scan. Do not infer that an arbitrary webpage can access the exposed desktop bridge.

usageContracts.structural: Default enabled=false, timestamps/error=null, arrays/cache empty. Public scanState spreads persisted values, isScanning=(scanPromise!==null), provider presence=(sessions.length>0 || dailyAggregates.length>0). JSON load spreads defaults and parsed values before provider normalization; same-version cache is not generally runtime-validated.
usageContracts.effects: setEnabled mutates memory before awaited queued write and returns current scan state; write failure rejects without rollback. refresh disabled resolves immediately. Enabled refresh first reads metadata/fingerprint outside scan catch, then skips if !force, truthy last completion, age<300000 and equal fingerprint. Any truthy force bypasses freshness, including the string 'false'. Scan is single-flight once runScan is reached; disabling does not cancel it.
usageContracts.recovery: Scan start stamps startedAt and clears error. Changed fingerprint supplies default previous cache; success replaces sessions/daily/source cache/fingerprint, stamps completedAt, clears error. Scan throw retains last successful projection/fingerprint/completion and stores message; scan persistence failures are swallowed. Metadata/fingerprint failure can reject before scan. Writer serializes current state when its queued turn runs; generation veto prevents older rename, queued failures are logged and queue continues, flush waits caught pending promise. No durability guarantee from a resolved scan.

usageContracts.structural: getSnapshot is synchronous cached projection with limit default10. Other four query getters await refresh(false) and may still return stale/default/error-bearing projections. Recent default12 for Claude/Codex,10 for OpenCode. Native slice(0,limit) semantics remain: undefined default, null/0/NaN empty, negative omits tail, fractional/string coercion, huge/Infinity all.
usageContracts.selection: Only scope==='orca' activates source filters; unrecognized scopes otherwise admit broad data, while Claude/Codex nested location selectors use scope==='all' else Orca. This can make malformed-scope totals inconsistent. Only kind==='model' selects model, other kinds project. Unknown range follows 90d; all has no cutoff. Calendar windows start local midnight, days-1 inclusive, not UTC duration subtraction. Snapshot always includes both breakdowns; arrays contain actual occupied days, no zero fill.

usageContracts.structural: Worktree index includes local repositories (!connectionId), first duplicate repository ID, repository roots and persisted worktree/folder paths; dedup uses raw paths and fingerprint sorted JSON of repoId/worktreeId/path/displayName. No git worktree list or automatic remote-home scan. Provider log attribution is data from local scanner inputs, not proof of foreign host ownership.
usageContracts.effects: Claude caches file mtime/size with dedupe keys/deferred claims, reparses claims whose owner disappeared, processes cached claims then parsed claims, batches four reads with event-loop yields and merges sessions/daily. Codex uses streamed JSONL and context (previous totals/cwd/model), canonical worktree discovery and legacy copy offsets, advances parse context before rejecting duplicate claims, incremental invalidation and periodic yields. OpenCode opens SQLite readonly/fileMustExist/query_only and always closes; canonical DB priority/dedup claim is by whole session, demotes lower-priority cached owners, reparses deferred claims, preserves recorded nullable cost.
usageContracts.limit: The actual three scanner entry bodies were read. Local discovery/parser/attribution implementations are named input contracts, not external libraries or a new recursive scope. Provider JSONL/SQLite versions, filesystem failures and pricing/attribution correctness require original parser/scanner fixtures; this report closes store-to-scanner invocation/state handling, not every ingestion algorithm.

usageContracts.structural: Shared slices start scope=orca,range=30d, scanState/summary=null, arrays empty. Use only getScanState/setEnabled/refresh/getSnapshot. Undefined scanState is paired-web no-op; disabled stops after state update. Enabled reads initial snapshot and publishes if completedAt!==null or global presence, then refreshes and reads/publishes a second snapshot. Snapshot request limit10. Enabling clears projections and requests forced fetch; scope/range changes update immediately then fetch.
usageContracts.effects: No request-generation/selection guard or disposed flag; stale overlapping fetch may overwrite newer selection, and disabling does not invalidate earlier fetch. IPC rejection is logged, can leave optimistic isScanning true. Mount fetches; off/null scan state shows opt-in; absent summary with scanning or never-completed shows loading; filtered summary presence may hide globally present data. Error and last-updated state are visible. Claude has eight cards/cache metrics; Codex/OpenCode six/event metrics. Claude/Codex share requires summary and daily data; OpenCode pane has no share button.
